unverified_requirements.text: Reconstruct the vintage typewriter: its sloped casing, repeated keyboard rows and space bar, curved typebar basket, platen and carriage, side knobs, paper supports and the sheet of paper. Preserve keyboard spacing, the layered carriage mechanism and the large opening above the keys. Match the dark casing, metal components and aged surface character. Tiny key legends, labels and exact printed text are optional; typing operation is not required.
unverified_requirements.reason: Only native primary appearance is measured; semantic geometry/visible-surface/region completeness is not verified.

unverified_requirements.text: Use real editable three-dimensional geometry. Preserve continuous curvature, thickness, recesses, openings, thin structures, connections and occlusions. Distinct components should be editable objects or clearly separable mesh islands; organic surfaces may remain continuous. Exact source topology, vertex count and object names are not required. Image planes or camera-facing shells are not substitutes for full geometry.
